devdoc.details: All approve/finalize txs flow through a single relayer EOA so that         msg.sender does not leak the signer's wallet.

approve(uint256,bytes32,bytes).details: Idempotent: a signer approving twice does NOT increment the counter.

initialize(bytes32[],bytes,uint8).details: Restricted to the relayer EOA to block front-running between deploy         and init. The encrypted owner set is bound to (this contract,         relayer EOA) on the FE side, so only the relayer can submit it.

proposeAddSigner(bytes32,bytes).details: FHE.fromExternal runs at propose time so the resulting eaddress carries      contract-permanent ACL by the time finalizeExecute calls _execAddSigner.

devdoc.title: HiddenMultisig

InvalidKMSSignatures().notice: Returned if the returned KMS signatures are not valid.

SenderNotAllowedToUseHandle(bytes32,addr.notice: Returned if the sender is not allowed to use the handle.

ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

PublicDecryptionVerified(bytes32[],bytes.notice: This event is emitted when public decryption has been successfully verified.

approve(uint256,bytes32,bytes).notice: Submit an encrypted signer-address as an approval for a proposal.

finalizeExecute(uint256,bytes,bytes).notice: Finalize execution by submitting the off-chain decryption result         along with KMS signatures. checkSignatures reverts on bad proof.

initialize(bytes32[],bytes,uint8).notice: One-shot initialization: register encrypted owner addresses and threshold.

requestExecute(uint256).notice: Request decryption of the threshold-met flag. The relayer fetches         the cleartext and decryption proof off-chain (via Gateway/KMS),         then calls finalizeExecute.

userdoc.notice: Confidential multisig payroll: signer identities are encrypted on-chain         using Zama FHE. Approvals authenticated by encrypted equality against         the encrypted owner set; threshold met-or-not is decided via off-chain         KMS public decryption verified on-chain by FHE.checkSignatures.
